Dear Pankaj Bhaiya,

Remember you told me to watch when I pick up my phone? I tried it for three days. I'm a bit shocked.

I reach for it the second anything goes quiet. Waiting for the bus. When the teacher is writing on the board. When the kettle is boiling. Even in the ad break of a show I'm already watching on a screen!

Naveen

I'm Aditi. Last month, Ma'am made us do this exercise: every time you pick up your phone, put a tick on your hand. By lunchtime, my hand was covered. I'd picked it up at every tiny gap. Walking between classes. Waiting for the photocopy. While my friend was talking, even.

It's like my brain learned: bored equals phone. It doesn't ask me first.
So now, at lunch, the phone's in the drawer. The first few days I kept reaching for my pocket. Now I actually talk to people. It's a bit uncomfortable. But also kind of nice.
